We have all steps. Need to construct final JSON route with root target and children reactions in order, each reaction node with template_id (as integer? example uses number). Provide children as precursor molecules (type mol). For reactions that produce multiple precursors, we need list of children each mol.

We have:

Step1 (template 29646) applied to target gave three possible precursors; we selected the second? Actually we used second candidate for step2. But for route we need to include the precursor we actually used for next step. That is the second candidate: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". We'll use that as child of step1.

Step2 (template 1914389) applied to that gave two precursors: A = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO" and B = "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". We'll include both as children of step2.

Step3 (template 1914390) applied to A gave precursor C = "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". We'll use that as child of step3. (B not further transformed.)

Step4 (template 149040) applied to C gave two precursors: D = "CC(C)(C)[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F" and E = "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". We'll include both as children of step4.

Step5 (template 1914391) applied to E gave two precursors: F = "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](C=O)O1" and G = "COC#CC(C)P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F". We'll include both as children of step5.

Now construct JSON.

Make sure template_id as integer (no quotes) per example. Provide children arrays.

Let's produce final answer.
